source: scratch workspace: library crates member-1 to member-24, each made with cargo new --lib --vcs none (edition 2024); member-N for N from 2 to 24 has the dependency member-(N-1) = { path = "../member-(N-1)" }, a chain from member-24 down to member-1; root Cargo.toml is [workspace] with resolver = "2" and members = ["member-*"]; no registry dependencies, run by capture-shaping.sh in /repo
